messages:
Gabi M: Quick design flag from mobile QA — the condensed toolbar that replaces the left rail at ~600-680px needs a stronger affordance. Users don't realize it's expandable; we got a couple reports where they think the chevron is a label, not an interaction. Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots/condensed-toolbar-1.png :thinking_face:

Ethan R: Seen this. Current chevron is tiny and not reachable by some touch patterns. We should increase touch target to 44px and add a draggable handle so a swipe-up reveals the full nav instead of relying on the chevron only.

Kim S: +1 for a visible drag handle. Accessibility notes: the handle must have aria-label="Open navigation" and be keyboard operable (space/enter to toggle). For reduced-motion, animate opacity only, avoid layout changes.

Rachel T: From product POV we need the condensed toolbar to show the current model clearly. Proposal: show the model name truncated to one line with a chevron and a small subtitle "tap to switch" on the first open. Copy: use "Model: <name>" on very narrow screens to disambiguate.

Gabi M: Nice. Also two mobile overflow problems: 1) long IDs in the "Source" column create a horizontal scroll at ~640px. 2) when the rail overlays the table the action chevrons get hidden. Proposed fixes: clamp source to 2 lines w/ ellipsis + a inline "View" pill, and make the header offset dynamic based on nav height.

Ethan R: For the clamp I suggest CSS:```css
.cell { display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; }
.view-pill { margin-left:8px; }
```For the header offset we can expose a CSS var --nav-height and update it on open/close. Simple JS:```js
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--nav-height', `${nav.offsetHeight}px`);
```

Kim S: Tooltip & long-press pattern: mobile can't hover, so use a 500ms long-press to show a small tooltip/panel with full text and a copy button. Ensure the tooltip is focusable and has role="dialog" when opened via keyboard. Also announce with aria-live="polite".

Gabi M: UX detail: the drag handle should be a 28px-wide pill centered under the toolbar with a faint shadow. If users swipe the handle up we open bottomsheet nav. If they tap, it toggles. Keeps both discoverability and direct access.

Ethan R: Gesture conflicts: we need a horizontal deadzone so table swipes don't accidentally open the nav. Ignore vertical drags where horizontal delta > vertical delta by 1.2x and require at least 30% of handle travel to trigger open. Pseudo:```js
if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) * 1.2 && Math.abs(dy) > handleHeight*0.3) openNav();
```

Rachel T: Copy tweak: instead of "tap to switch" maybe show a transient hint only the first time the user sees the condensed toolbar. Keep it small. Also track metric: how often they open nav from condensed toolbar vs full nav to measure discoverability.

ux-ci-bot: Visual test regression: toast vs condensed toolbar z-index conflict on widths 590-620px (regression id: toolbar-toast-overlap-2026-03-23). Also keyboard-nav test failing: focus ring missing on the new handle when tabbing.

Kim S: I'll add CSS for focus-visible on the handle and ensure it has tabindex="0". Also add an aria-describedby that references the transient hint when present. For reduced-motion: collapse the animation to a fade only. Example CSS:```css
.handle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .nav-transition { transition: none; } }
```

Ethan R: For toasts, simplest fix is to move toasts to top-right on widths < 680px or bump toast z-index while nav is open. Prefer moving location so they don't compete with nav gestures.

Gabi M: Action items: Kim to add accessible handle + focus styles (EOD), Ethan to prototype header offset var + gesture deadzone, Rachel to update copy and metric tracking, ux-ci-bot to re-run visual tests after changes. I'll schedule a short playtest on actual devices tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

mobile-preview-bot: Preview build deployed: https://preview.redwood/ux/toolbar-handle-affordance (build 2026.03.23-1705)

Gabi M: Thanks all — tagging design sync for follow-up and will attach the short screen recording to the ticket.
